name: pokedon
notes: Restaurant's own Clover COLO2 storefront (slug pokedon-sandiego), read via the RSC flight payload, prices in integer cents. The merchant's own address field in the Clover payload reads "6345 EL CAJON BLVD 130" (the Rive apartment complex, not this business) vs our batch's 6353 El Cajon Blvd #130 - a typo in Clover's merchant profile, not a different location: five independent sources (Yelp, Grubhub, order.online, Apple Maps, Mapquest) all give 6353 El Cajon Blvd Ste 130 for pokedon, matching our batch exactly. 6 of the 6 Signature Bowls carry no flat price and were priced via --with-required-modifiers at their cheapest required size (Small, $16.00, same as the listed Create Your Own Small) - Large size would run higher; noting this per playbook. 13 priced items across all 3 categories on the storefront (Create Your Own, Signature Bowls, Drinks) - a small build-your-own poke shop menu, no sections were dropped.

name: Bay Club Bar & Grill
notes: Hotel restaurant; no menu content on the hotel's own CMS page, but it links 6 dated PDF menus (own domain, PDFs served from bayclubhotel.com): Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Happy Hour, a standalone Cocktails menu (image-only PDF, read as a page image), and a Beer & Wine List. Sections are prefixed with their source menu/daypart since some items (e.g. Bay Club Burger, Caesar Salad, Iceberg Wedge Salad, Bay Club Steak Sandwich) recur across Lunch/Dinner/Happy Hour at different prices - not deduplicated per playbook. The Beer & Wine List PDF has a two-column table layout that both pdftotext -layout and -raw failed to reliably pair for the WHITE WINE and RED WINE sections (row counts between the name column and price column do not line up 1:1, with some named wines showing no price at all) - those individually named bottles were dropped rather than guessed. The HOUSE WINE and CHAMPAGNE & SPARKLING WINE portions of that same list paired cleanly one-price-per-line and were kept, along with the two Draft/Bottled Beer category headers which is where beer selections live but which carry no printed prices anywhere (dropped, no price to file). Happy Hour's own Beer & Wine section is separate and unambiguous (single header price covering a named list of choices) and was kept in full.

name: Rosa's Ice Cream and Fruit Bar
blocked: Open ice cream/fruit bar at 4531 University Ave (confirmed via Yelp, Apple Maps, Facebook, all matching batch address). Only priced source found is this restaurant's own DoorDash JSON-LD (52 items), but it fails the markup test: dividing every price by 1.12 lands 51 of 52 items cleanly on round or quarter/half/.95-dollar values (e.g. $3.08->$2.75, $8.68->$7.75, $15.12->$13.50, $12.04->$10.75), indicating a ~12% platform fee baked into the displayed prices rather than the wall price. The restaurant's own ordering widget (orderrosasicecreamandfruitbar.mobile-webview6.com, a MenuStar-pattern site, restaurant_id 13272 on themenustar6.com) renders no priced HTML and its function=get_items/get_categories API calls returned empty bodies, so no unmarked-up first-party source was reachable to use instead. Per standing rule, a confirmed-markup delivery listing with no dine-in artefact to corroborate the true price is held rather than filed with adjusted numbers.

name: 8th & B Poke
blocked: Open Hawaiian poke shop at 806 B Ave, National City (confirmed via Toast's own restaurant record, address matches batch exactly: 806 B Ave, National City, CA 91950 - not a wrong-branch case despite National City having other poke shops, Poke Etc. and Blue Poke, at different addresses). The restaurant has a Toast profile (order.toasttab.com/online/8thandbpoke) but its own GraphQL state shows hasOnlineOrderingModule:false and no menu data is served - it is a hours/location page only, not an ordering menu. The batch's own website (8thandbpoke.com) is an empty/unbuilt Weebly site with no content, matching the router's finding. Not listed on DoorDash, Uber Eats, or Grubhub (targeted searches found only other poke shops nationwide). Yelp (493 photos, likely includes menu-board photos) is bot-walled to curl. No priced source reachable.

name: Bistro Kaz
blocked: Confirmed open at 3904 Convoy St, San Diego (address matches batch). Only one priced source reachable: menupages.com (204 items, tier-5/low per playbook, requires a second independent priced source agreeing). Restaurant's own site (bistrokaz.twupro.com) is a generic placeholder template with no real prices. Grubhub page returns zero prices (search snippet says delisted). DoorDash and Uber Eats store pages both fetch successfully (HTTP 200) but their menu data is client-side rendered only -- zero "price" occurrences and empty/absent Menu JSON-LD blocks on both, so no second priced source could be extracted via bare fetch. Per playbook rule for tier-5 sources ('if only one tier-5 source is reachable, mark blocked'), filing blocked rather than found despite having a full 204-item priced menupages listing.
